name: screenshare-p2p
description: Ultra low latency 1080p P2P screen sharing with audio for couples

scripts.build-helper: powershell -Command "$cargo = if (Get-Command cargo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'cargo' } else { (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cargo\bin\cargo.exe') }; & $cargo build --release --manifest-path tools/audio-helper/Cargo.toml; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path bin | Out-Null; Copy-Item tools\audio-helper\target\release\streamgrid-audio-helper.exe -Destination bin\streamgrid-audio-helper.exe -Force"
scripts.build-windows: npm run build-helper && npx @neutralinojs/neu build && powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist\StreamGrid\bin | Out-Null; Copy-Item bin\streamgrid-audio-helper.exe -Destination dist\StreamGrid\bin\streamgrid-audio-helper.exe -Force; Get-ChildItem -Path dist\StreamGrid -Include *linux*, *mac* | Remove-Item -Force; Compress-Archive -Path dist\StreamGrid -DestinationPath dist\StreamGrid-Windows.zip -Force"
